Title: Execute baseline call exactly as captured
Expected Result: No error. User/Role path, ProcessTitle=1 (My Tasks). Returns 4 result sets: (1) process instances; (2) activity instances, one row per process, the latest by StartDate (RANK=1), where both process and activity are open (IsActive=1) and the activity is on an element tagged BSP on which user 285 holds the activity's ExecutorRoleID, or is executed by user 285; (3) one row, ProcessInstanceID = NULL; (4) SLA rows for the returned processes. Processes missing a ProcessType, ProcessPriority or SupportedClient attribute are never returned. Record the row count of each set; later cases compare against them.

Title: Re-execute baseline call (repeatability)
Expected Result: Same rows as TC001, compared as sets: there is no ORDER BY, so row order can differ. Reads use NOLOCK, so counts can drift if data changes between runs.

Title: ProcessTitle = 2 (All Requests)
Expected Result: Reads the SupportedElementTypes attribute of RoleID 346314. If it is set: activities executed by user 285 plus every activity on tagged elements of those element types (no role-membership check). If it is not set: activities executed by user 285 plus unassigned activities whose ExecutorRoleID is one of the user's groups. Set (2) has IsUserTaskExecutor = 1 only where Executor = 285.

Title: ProcessTitle = 3 (My Requests)
Expected Result: Only processes with TriggeredBy = 285 (the latest activity of each). Element tags and RoleID are ignored; only process-design tags (ElementTypeID 2008) still filter by name.

Title: ProcessTitle = 0 (undefined value)
Expected Result: No error and no validation. Takes the 'All Tasks' branch without SupportedElementTypes: activities executed by user 285 plus unassigned activities of the user's groups.
Suspected Defect: No validation of @ProcessTitle; undefined values silently run the 'All Tasks' path.

Title: ProcessTitle = NULL
Expected Result: No error. Behaves like TC007 (every comparison with NULL is false).

Title: Empty @FilterTags
Expected Result: No error. NF.uspGetElementsByTags_OPT receives no tags, so no tag-based activities. Activities executed directly by user 285 (Executor = 285) are still returned.

Title: Two element tags (BSP + $(AltTagName))
Expected Result: Rows for either tag. Row count >= TC001. No duplicate processes (one activity per process).

Title: Non-existent tag
Expected Result: No error. Not necessarily zero rows: tag-based activities disappear, but activities executed directly by user 285 are still returned (same as TC010).

Title: Same tag supplied twice
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001 (reference elements are DISTINCT). If the TVP has a primary key, the duplicate INSERT fails; that is also acceptable.

Title: BSP tag + process-design tag (ElementTypeID 2008)
Expected Result: Subset of TC001: only processes with ProcessName = '$(ProcessName)', plus processes whose ProcessName is NULL.

Title: Process-design tag only
Expected Result: No element tags, so like TC010 (only activities executed by user 285), then filtered to ProcessName = '$(ProcessName)'.

Title: IsOpenActivity = 0
Expected Result: Only closed processes (PID.IsActive = 0) with their latest closed activity. No overlap with TC001's processes.

Title: IsOpenActivity = NULL
Expected Result: Open and closed processes. Process count >= TC001 and >= TC020.

Title: IsReferenceElementTasks = 1 (element tag only)
Expected Result: Reference-element path: the latest activity of each process whose activity RefElementVersionID = ObjectID of the BSP tag. Respects IsOpenActivity and the date filter. Does not check the user or role (see TC034).

Title: IsReferenceElementTasks = 1 + one process-design tag + one element tag
Preconditions: $(ProcessName) is a real process name that has open activities on the BSP-tagged element (and $(AltTagObjectID) a real element).
Expected Result: Activities of processes named '$(ProcessName)' on elements tagged against the BSP tag's ObjectID (via Tag.TagMap).

Title: IsReferenceElementTasks = 1 + process-design tag + TWO element tags
Preconditions: $(ProcessName) is a real process name that has open activities on the BSP-tagged element (and $(AltTagObjectID) a real element).
Expected Result: Fails with error 512 'Subquery returned more than 1 value' from T.SourceObjectID = (SELECT RefElementVersionID FROM @ReferenceElementFilter). It should return activities for both elements.
Suspected Defect: Scalar subquery '= (SELECT ... FROM @ReferenceElementFilter)' fails with error 512 when more than one element tag is passed. Use IN or a JOIN.

Title: IsReferenceElementTasks = 1 + TWO process-design tags + element tag
Preconditions: $(ProcessName) is a real process name that has open activities on the BSP-tagged element (and $(AltTagObjectID) a real element).
Expected Result: Fails with error 512 from PID.ProcessName = (SELECT ProcessName FROM @ProcessNameFilter). It should return activities for both process names.
Suspected Defect: Scalar subquery '= (SELECT ProcessName FROM @ProcessNameFilter)' fails with error 512 when more than one process-design tag is passed.

Title: IsReferenceElementTasks = 1 with a non-existent UserID
Expected Result: Same rows as TC030: the reference-element path has no user or role check. Confirm this is intended; otherwise it is an authorisation gap.
Suspected Defect: Reference-element path returns the same activities for any @UserID / @RoleID (no security filter).

Title: IsReferenceElementTasks = 1 and IsChildElementTasks = 1 with a parent
Expected Result: Same as TC030: the reference-element branch takes priority, and the child-task flags are ignored.

Title: IsChildElementTasks = 1, ParentProcessInstanceID = 0
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001. The child branch needs ParentProcessInstanceID > 0, so the user/role path runs.

Title: IsChildElementTasks = 1, valid ParentProcessInstanceID
Expected Result: The latest activity of every child process of $(ParentProcessInstanceID). User, role, tags (except process-design), IsOpenActivity and the dates are not applied.

Title: IsChildElementTasks = 1 + parent + IsOpenActivity = 0 + date range
Expected Result: Same rows as TC041: the child branch ignores IsOpenActivity, StartDate and EndDate. Confirm with the business whether these filters should apply.

Title: IsChildElementTasks = 1, ParentProcessInstanceID = -1
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001 (-1 is not > 0, so the user/role path runs).

Title: IsChildElementTasks = 1, non-existent parent
Expected Result: No error. Sets (1), (2) and (4) are empty.

Title: Valid parent but IsChildElementTasks = 0
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001. ParentProcessInstanceID is ignored without the flag.

Title: IsMobileEnabled = 1
Expected Result: Subset of TC001: only processes whose SupportedClient attribute = 2.

Title: IsMobileEnabled = 0
Expected Result: Subset of TC001: SupportedClient <> 2. TC050 + TC051 processes = TC001 processes.

Title: IsPersistentDataRequired = 1
Expected Result: A 5th result set (persistent data) is returned and should hold the activities' app data. Currently it is always empty: AssociatedAppID is inserted as NULL into #ActivitiesTVP, so #ElementRootMap is empty.
Suspected Defect: Output 5 (persistent data) is always empty: #FilteredActivitiesTVP.AssociatedAppID is always NULL.

Title: IsPersistentDataRequired = 0
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001 (4 result sets).

Title: StartDate only
Expected Result: Subset of TC001: activity StartDate BETWEEN $(StartDate) AND GETDATE().

Title: EndDate only
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001: EndDate is only used when StartDate is set. A user filtering 'up to a date' gets no filtering.

Title: StartDate and EndDate
Expected Result: Activity StartDate BETWEEN $(StartDate) AND $(EndDate). Subset of TC060.

Title: StartDate later than EndDate
Expected Result: No error. Sets (1), (2) and (4) are empty (BETWEEN with an inverted range matches nothing).

Title: StartDate = EndDate (date only, single day)
Expected Result: Should return activities started on that day. Actually returns only activities starting exactly at 00:00:00, because the DATETIME2 BETWEEN uses midnight as the end. If the application sends date-only values, same-day searches miss data.
Suspected Defect: Date-only @EndDate excludes the rest of that day (BETWEEN on DATETIME2 with a midnight upper bound).

Title: StartDate in the future, EndDate NULL
Expected Result: No error. Empty: BETWEEN '2099-01-01' AND GETDATE() is an inverted range.

Title: Widest range (1900-01-01 to 9999-12-31)
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001. No overflow.

Title: ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo = 2 with range
Expected Result: Same rows as TC062: the parameter is not used ('TODO' in the code). Activity StartDate is always the filtered column.
Suspected Defect: @ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo is not implemented; every value filters on activity StartDate.

Title: ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo = 99 (invalid) with range
Expected Result: Same rows as TC062. No validation.

Title: ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo = NULL with range
Expected Result: Same rows as TC062.

Title: @ProcessStatus with one value
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001: @ProcessStatus is not used (the code says the SLA check is done in C#).

Title: @ProcessStatus with non-existent value (-1)
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001 (parameter ignored).

Title: @ProcessTriggers with one value
Expected Result: Subset of TC001: processes with TriggerSource = $(TriggerValue), plus processes whose TriggerSource is NULL.

Title: @ProcessTriggers with two values
Expected Result: TriggerSource IN ($(TriggerValue), $(AltTriggerValue)) or NULL. Rows >= TC075.

Title: @ProcessTriggers with non-existent value (-1)
Expected Result: Not zero rows: processes with a NULL TriggerSource always pass the filter. Confirm that NULL should be included.
Suspected Defect: Rows with NULL TriggerSource / ProcessType / ProcessPriority always pass those filters.

Title: @ProcessTypes with one value
Expected Result: Subset of TC001: ProcessType = $(TypeValue) (from ProcessActionParameters, else the process attribute), or ProcessType NULL, or the tag-mapped type (see TC083).

Title: @ProcessTypes with two values
Expected Result: ProcessType IN ($(TypeValue), $(AltTypeValue)) or NULL. Rows >= TC080.

Title: @ProcessTypes with non-existent value (-1)
Expected Result: Only processes whose ProcessType is NULL (often zero rows, because ProcessType comes from a mandatory attribute).

Title: @ProcessTypes = 5244 (FixRequest tag mapping)
Expected Result: Includes processes with ProcessType > 20 whose process element carries tag 'FixRequest' (ElementTypeID 6263). Repeat with 5239, 5238, 5243 and 5242 for InvestigationRequest, OSW, IntegratedAssurance and IAPowerStation.

Title: @ProcessPriorities with one value
Expected Result: Subset of TC001: ProcessPriority = $(PriorityValue), or NULL.

Title: @ProcessPriorities with two values
Expected Result: ProcessPriority IN ($(PriorityValue), $(AltPriorityValue)) or NULL. Rows >= TC085.

Title: @ProcessPriorities with non-existent value (-1)
Expected Result: Only processes whose ProcessPriority is NULL (often zero rows).

Title: Omit all four filter-value TVP parameters
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001 (omitted TVPs default to empty).

Title: Non-existent UserID (999999999)
Expected Result: No error. Sets (1), (2) and (4) are empty: no role assignments and no activities executed by that user.

Title: UserID = NULL
Expected Result: No error. Sets (1), (2) and (4) are empty.

Title: UserID = 0
Expected Result: No error. Sets (1), (2) and (4) are empty.

Title: Non-existent RoleID with ProcessTitle = 1
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001: with ProcessTitle = 1 the procedure uses every role the user holds and ignores @RoleID (it is used only for SupportedElementTypes when ProcessTitle > 1, and for the time log). Confirm that 'My Tasks' should not be scoped to the selected role.
Suspected Defect: @RoleID is ignored for ProcessTitle = 1; tasks are not scoped to the selected role.

Title: RoleID = NULL with ProcessTitle = 1
Expected Result: Identical result sets to TC001.

Title: Different (non-admin) user and role
Expected Result: Only $(OtherUserID)'s tasks. No activity from TC001 that belongs only to 285 appears. Note: 285 is hard-coded as 'Nibras Admin' in CreatedUserName and ExecutorName.

Title: RoleID = -1 with ProcessTitle = 2
Expected Result: No error. No SupportedElementTypes are found, so it falls back to the user's group roles. Same as TC005 when role 346314 has no SupportedElementTypes attribute.

Title: Omit @UserID
Expected Result: Error 201: 'expects parameter @UserID, which was not supplied' (no default).

Title: Omit @ProcessTitle
Expected Result: Error 201: 'expects parameter @ProcessTitle' (no default).

Title: IsDebug = 1
Expected Result: Business result sets match TC001. Extra debug result sets (labelled '----------#...----------') appear in between.

Title: EnableTimeLog = 1 writes NF.ProcedureTimeLog
Expected Result: Result sets match TC001, and rows are inserted into NF.ProcedureTimeLog (the harness checks this, then rolls back).

Title: IsDebug = 1 and EnableTimeLog = 1
Expected Result: Like TC110, plus a final #TimeLog result set listing the step timings.

Title: All filters applied together
Expected Result: Rows satisfy every filter. A subset of TC062, TC050, TC075, TC080 and TC085.

Title: All nullable scalar parameters NULL
Expected Result: No error. Sets (1), (2) and (4) are empty (UserID NULL).

Title: Baseline call within time budget
Expected Result: Completes within $(MaxDurationMs) ms on a warm cache.

Title: @FilterTags with 500 rows
Expected Result: No error. Completes within $(MaxDurationMs) ms.

Title: Largest result: ProcessTitle 2, open and closed
Expected Result: Completes within $(MaxDurationMs) ms with the largest realistic result set.
